events.verdict: [Observable in enhanced video] Young (IND) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Young (IND) makes incidental contact with Clark (NOP) during the follow-through on his pass.
Clark (NOP) makes contact with Collison's (IND) arm after the release of his jump shot attempt and does not affect his ability to follow through naturally.
Turner (IND) establishes himself in a screening position in Clark's (NOP) defensive path and does not deliver the contact.
Clark (NOP) does not maintain legal guarding position as he is late to the spot when he makes contact with Collison (IND) that affects his SQBR.
Holiday (NOP) reaches in from behind and cleanly dislodges Bogdanovic (IND) of the ball.
RLB shows Joseph (IND) makes legal hand-on-ball contact with Okafor (NOP) after his gather.
Young (IND) makes marginal contact with Okafor's (NOP) side during his driving shot attempt.
Turner (IND) establishes himself in a screening position in Holiday's (NOP) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Holiday (NOP) makes contact with the ball as it is rolling off of the basket ring.
Okafor (NOP) moves into Turner's (IND) lower body and makes contact that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
[Observable in enhanced video] Collison (IND) moves his pivot foot heel-to-toe to create space.
Holiday (NOP) attempts to defend through the pick and makes contact with Collison (IND), but it is marginal and does not affect his SQBR.
Turner (IND) firms up during the pick to Holiday (NOP) and makes marginal contact that doesn't affect his ability to maintain his defensive position.
Collison (IND) allows the ball to come to rest against his body during his drive and continues to dribble.
Okafor (NOP) makes body-to-body contact with Collison (IND) that does not affect his ability to follow through naturally or return safely to the floor following the release of his shot attempt.
LAR shows Miller (NOP) initiates contact with Bogdanovic (IND) that otherwise would not occur without the unnatural extension of his legs during his upward shooting motion.
Turner (IND) engages and disengages with Okafor (NOP) during rebounding.
Clark (NOP) commits the take foul on Collison (IND).
Collison (IND) briefly has his arm around Okafor's (NOP) midsection and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
[Observable in enhanced video] Holiday (NOP) lands consecutively on the same foot he gathered on after receiving the pass.
Collison (IND) initiates contact with Clark (NOP) during the inbound that dislodges him from his legally obtained defensive position.
LAR shows Sabonis (IND) briefly has his hand around Diallo's (NOP) left arm, but does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Okafor (NOP) briefly grasps Turner's (IND) arm as the free throw is attempted, but releases without affecting his ability to retrieve the rebound.

Holiday (NOP) collides with Okafor (NOP) prior to the incidental contact from Turner (IND) during the rebound. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Holiday (NOP) enters the lane prior to the point at which the ball makes contact with the rim.
Joseph (IND) commits the take foul on Holiday (NOP), which occurs prior to Holiday's gather. The play is correctly deemed a personal foul.
Joseph (IND) and Holiday (NOP) make incidental contact with each other during the inbound.
